title: The review-freeze fingerprint changes after a byte-identical `git restore` until the paths are re-staged, because it runs git with global config off (no core.autocrlf) and the restore rewrote CRLF files and broke index stat data
outcome: The review-freeze fingerprint of a tree depends only on the tracked content (blobs, tree and index entries), not on worktree stat state or line-ending conversion. A byte-identical restore yields the same fingerprint without re-staging, and a test covers restore-then-fingerprint.
acceptance: The review-freeze fingerprint changes after a byte-identical `git restore` until the paths are re-staged, because it runs git with global config off (no core.autocrlf) and the restore rewrote CRLF files and broke index stat data is done
